dct_creator_sm: Atlantic Coastal Action Program (ACAP) Cape Breton.
dct_description_sm:
Data was collected during stream restoration efforts in these areas. Water quality monitoring shows change over the course of four years (2014-2017) both before and after digger logs, deflectors, debris jam removals, etc. were completed. 

This data was collected to monitor change in chemical makeup to ensure our restoration efforts contributed to more favorable salmonid habitat in these water bodies over the course of time.
dct_title_s: ACAP Cape Breton Water Quality Data - Stream Restoration (2014-2017)
